scope: Retrospective cross-series association discovery across active Macro-EIA and WDI Trade annual observations.

alignment.first_difference: value[t] - value[t-1] only when both exact consecutive annual observations exist
alignment.contemporaneous: one undirected metric pair per pair at lag zero
alignment.lead_lag: both ordered directions are evaluated for positive lag
alignment.missing_data: pairwise observed overlap only; never fill, interpolate, or convert missing values to zero
alignment.source_policy: preserve source namespaces and raw metric identities; never average or merge source measures
alignment.change_transform_policy: LOG_DIFFERENCE for strictly positive level/index/nominal measures; ABSOLUTE_DIFFERENCE for percentage/rate measures; mode pinned from source metadata and emitted per relationship

discovery.association_measure: median of within-entity Pearson correlations on metadata-selected annual changes
discovery.year_effect_adjustment: subtract cross-entity median first-difference for each metric/year, then compute within-entity correlation
discovery.candidate_thresholds: descriptive screening only; not inferential significance thresholds

inference_policy.available_at_policy: historical available_at and revision metadata are unknown; no point-in-time claim
